notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
description:
Cast Benevolent Geist from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {2}{U}.
Benevolent Geist enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Benevolent Geist by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
